name: Clipboard Actions
description: Paste clipboard text as plain text or save the current clipboard image without overwriting existing files.

descriptions.en: Paste clipboard text as plain text or save the current clipboard image without overwriting existing files.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将剪贴板文字以纯文本粘贴，或将当前剪贴板图片保存为不会覆盖旧文件的新 PNG。

author: mcx

preferences.label: Image save directory
preferences.description: Directory for images saved by the Save Clipboard Image command.

descriptions.en: Directory for images saved by the Save Clipboard Image command.
descriptions.zh-CN: “保存剪贴板图片”命令写入图片的目录。

commands.name: paste-clipboard-plain-text
commands.title: Paste Clipboard as Plain Text
commands.description: Replace the clipboard with its text representation and paste it into the previous foreground app.

descriptions.en: Replace the clipboard with its text representation and paste it into the previous foreground app.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将剪贴板替换为纯文本，并粘贴到之前的前台应用。

commands.name: save-clipboard-image
commands.title: Save Clipboard Image
commands.description: Save the current clipboard image as a unique PNG without overwriting an existing file.

descriptions.en: Save the current clipboard image as a unique PNG without overwriting an existing file.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将当前剪贴板图片保存为唯一 PNG 文件，不覆盖已有文件。
